owner_approval: Owner approved 60 Open Food Facts Taiwan nutrition_zh photos (about 28.9 MB) on 17 October 2026.

selection_rule.order: ascending SHA-256 of the UTF-8 13-digit barcode (code zero-padded to 13)

storage: Image bytes are kept outside the repository; none are committed.
sealing: Untouched files were hashed on download and written read-only to a separate sealed folder. They are not opened, viewed, OCR'd or sent to any model before the single frozen run.
